## Current LTS Model (Through Node.js 26)

Node.js releases go through three phases: 'Current', 'Active Long Term Support (LTS)', and 'Maintenance'. Odd-numbered release lines are not promoted to LTS.

### Current Supported Versions

- Node.js 22.x is in "Active LTS" until October 2025, then moves into "Maintenance" until end of life in April 2027.
- Node.js 24.x is in Active LTS with an end-of-life date of April 30, 2028.
- Node.js 26.x is currently in Current status, entering LTS on October 28, 2026, with end-of-life on April 30, 2029.

## New Release Schedule (Starting Node.js 27)

Starting with 27.x, Node.js will move from two major releases per year to one. As of October 2026, there will be one major release per year in April, with LTS promotion in October.

Under the new model, LTS duration will be 30 months with total support of 36 months from first Current release to End of Life.
